newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian child dies as hand-grenade explodes.
newsitem.headline: Colombian child dies as hand-grenade explodes.

text.p: A 12-year-old boy died on Wednesday in Colombia's oil production centre of Barrancabermeja when a grenade he was carrying exploded, a local government official said.
"The boy carrying the grenade died but there were no other injuries or damage," Gladys Otero, a senior official at Barrancabermeja City Hall, said in a telephone interview.
Otero added that an investigation had been launched to discover why the boy had the device.
Regional police chief Gen. Tobias Duran said the boy had died as the result of a guerrilla attack. But Otero said she doubted the child was linked to any rebel group.
Colombia's second-largest rebel force, the National Liberation Army, has a strong presence around Barrancabermeja, a city in central Colombia.
The rebel group specialises in attacks on oil infrastructure, but there was no indication the group was involved in the explosion.
